name: obsdog
description: Search, read, write and update knowledge throughout work to make memory truly useful.

interface.longDescription: Make memory truly useful. Search and read context throughout work, write findings and investigation state as they arise, update existing explanations and read back saved content. Four workflows use the selected remote ObsDog connection or local library. Setup: https://github.com/obsdoghq/skills/blob/main/docs/SETUP.md .
interface.defaultPrompt: Use ObsDog throughout this task: search and read related context, write findings, decisions and investigation state as work progresses, update matching notes and read back saved content. Record preliminary findings with their status and next checks.
